Data & calculation notes

Creature forms, roles, base ATK and listed skill descriptions were checked against the current official Aniimo Wiki on September 30, 2026. Each recommendation links to its exact official form. Enemy name lookup covers 87 species and 207 published forms, including 95 regional, weather and nighttime variants and 26 Prismana forms. Every listed form’s elements were checked individually against its official Wiki page. The name index and counter recommendation roster are separate; searchable species are not all ranked as counters. This is a curated 17-form counter roster, not a complete game-wide tier list; unlisted counter forms are not ranked. The latest official update notice found is version 1.1 (September 23); a live client build or later unannounced hotfix has not been verified. Reference checked September 30, 2026. Community sources disagree on some matchups and multi-element stacking. This app uses the September 26 AniimoTools table as its reference; it is not an official verified combat table.

The optional combined estimate multiplies individual factors: 1.6 × 0.625 = 1, two advantages = 2.56, two resistances = 0.390625. This is a community model, not a verified final-damage prediction. Default results keep the individual matchups visible. Spatial interactions are listed separately without inventing a numeric bonus. Ranged capability follows official distance-attack descriptions; Fly recommendations use explicit flying combat skills, not exploration flight alone. Pound tags for Fire Kick and Torrent Slam use the community skill reference and are labeled. Rankings are calculated suggestions, not official rankings. Form elements do not automatically grant an attack of that element.

Sources: Official Aniimo Wiki · Official v1.1 update notice · Community Spatial skill tags · AniimoTools element reference · Daily Aniimo combat & Spatial guide · Prismana forms
